headlines.title: GE Vernova (GEV) Lands 372 MW Côte D’Ivoire Power Plant Order
headlines.summary: GE Vernova (NYSE:GEV) has secured an order to supply a gas turbine and generator for a 372-MW power plant in Côte d’Ivoire. The equipment will support a combined-cycle facility that is expected to contribute to Côte d’Ivoire’s grid capacity in West Africa. This agreement marks GE Vernova’s direct entry into a major Côte d’Ivoire power project as it seeks more Gas Power opportunities in new markets.

description: GE Vernova Inc., an energy company, engages in the provision of various products and services that generate, transfer, orchestrate, convert, and store electricity in the United States, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. The company operates through three segments: Power, Wind, and Electrification. The Power segment designs, manufactures, and services gas, nuclear, hydro, and steam technologies. It serves industrial, government, and other customers. The Wind segment offers wind generation technologies, including onshore and offshore wind turbines and blades. The Electrification segment provides grid solutions; power conversion; electrification software; and solar and storage solutions technologies required for the transmission, distribution, conversion, storage, and orchestration of electricity from point of generation to point of consumption. The company was incorporated in 2023 and is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
